title: TERMS-Bench: Diagnosing LLM Negotiation Agents Beyond Deal Rate
authors: Erica Zhang, Fangzhao Zhang, Aneesh Pappu, Batu El, Jose Blanchet, Susan Athey, Jiashuo Liu, James Zou
abstract: TERMS-Bench is a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLM negotiation agents in multi-round bilateral price negotiation. Performance is decomposed along four independent axes — surplus efficiency, agreement calibration, opponent modeling, and procedural robustness — using a fixed, history-reactive counterpart policy that ensures reproducibility. Synthetic and data-grounded variants reveal failure modes invisible to deal-rate scoring alone.
